policy: Frozen before the implementation. Old B2 is main cc758cb; new B2 is this branch. Targets: the 4 real-PDF edits PR #100 saved with an approved line decoration; PR #100 restored 1 of them (P7-07) from the saved PDF alone. Every step approves exactly the decoration candidates its own proposal lists; an approval is never carried from one step to another. A refusal ends its case and never counts as success; fixture successes are reported apart from real-PDF successes.
procedure: edit, approving the listed candidates; save
reopen the saved PDF alone; propose the restoring edit; record its candidates
save the restoring edit without approving them (a step needing one must be refused)
save it approving exactly the listed candidates
measures: per step: saved or refused (reason), the existing audits, structure, continued editing, the move audits of PR #100; restored PDF against the source: glyph origins (0.01 pt and 0.001 pt, largest offset), unchanged paragraph glyphs and source line breaks, page text (MuPDF, Poppler), search hits, drawings (0.01 pt), images (shading rasters by count, colour space and area), link targets with /Rect and /QuadPoints (0.001 pt), structure; pixels at 72 and 150 dpi reported apart
target: at least 2 more real restorations than PR #100 (3 of 4 or more)
